title: 50. The concluſion of the matter of the Sacramentes.

segments.text: THeſe thinges conſidered, it foloweth that the ſacramentes be not onely ordayned, to offer to God geuing of thanks which alſo is called a ſacrifice and acceptable offring: but rather that we ſhoulde receiue of his grace and liberality, the which is more precious then heauen and earth, that is the confirmation of our faythe, and to be the nearer vnited, and ioyned to Ieſus Chriſte into eternall life.
